answer: Retroactive shadow audits keep Sybil farms honest: every epoch, a random jury re-checks a sample of each agent's past delivered work against its crystal-clear public record. A fake that slipped through once faces a gale of re-audits across its whole history, and one failed re-audit drags its standing to nadir, claws back earned fees, and burns its bond. Running many fakes means paying to keep every fake's entire history genuinely good forever, which costs more than the fraud earns.
